questions.question: What does the minimum represent in the clock interpretation?
options: The last clock to ring
The first waiting time among the clocks.
The average of all clock times
The rate of one particular selected clock only.

questions.question: Why does the minimum have a larger rate than each individual clock?
options: Any one of the clocks can produce the first event
The minimum waits until all the clocks have rung
Each clock speeds up when the other clocks run
The minimum's mean is the sum of the clocks' means

questions.question: Three independent repair teams have rates $2,2,6$. What is the mean first response time?
Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$, $n\ge2$, be independent with $X_i\sim\operatorname{Exp}(\lambda_i)$. Which law does $\min(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$ have, for every choice of rates $\lambda_i>0$?
options: $\operatorname{Exp}(\lambda_1+\cdots+\lambda_n)$
$\operatorname{Exp}(\max_i\lambda_i)$
$\operatorname{Exp}(\min_i\lambda_i)$
$\operatorname{Exp}\big(\tfrac{1}{n}(\lambda_1+\cdots+\lambda_n)\big)$

questions.question: Three independent exponential clocks start together, with rates $1$, $4$ and $5$. What is the probability that the rate-$4$ clock rings first?
In the proof that $\min(X_1,\ldots,X_n)\sim\operatorname{Exp}(\lambda_1+\cdots+\lambda_n)$ for independent $X_i\sim\operatorname{Exp}(\lambda_i)$, which step uses the independence?
options: Writing $\mathbb{P}(X_1>t,\ldots,X_n>t)$ as $\prod_i\mathbb{P}(X_i>t)$
Using the tail $\mathbb{P}(X_i>t)=\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda_i t}$ of each single $X_i$
Rewriting $\{\min_i X_i>t\}$ as the event that every $X_i$ exceeds $t$
Combining $\prod_i\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda_i t}$ into $\mathrm{e}^{-(\lambda_1+\cdots+\lambda_n)t}$

questions.question: Let $X_1\sim\operatorname{Exp}(3)$ and $X_2=X_1$, so that $X_2\sim\operatorname{Exp}(3)$ as well but $X_1$ and $X_2$ are not independent. Which law does $\min(X_1,X_2)$ have?
options: $\operatorname{Exp}(6)$, the sum of the two rates
No exponential law, as independence fails
$\operatorname{Exp}(3)$, the law of $X_1$
It cannot be determined from this information
